$comment: Read by deploy/third-party-notices.cs, which adds these to every THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt it writes.
licences: the SPDX expression of each package whose .nuspec names a licence file instead of an expression.
components: what the deliverables ship that no *.deps.json names as a package. A component is listed when a
deps.json given to the generator names the library in 'with' (a package or one of this repository's projects) and,
if 'runtimes' is set, targets a runtime identifier starting with one of them (a deps.json without one matches all).
'{Id}' in a version is that package's version. 'texts' are paths from the repository root; a component without
texts of its own gets the standard text of each licence in its expression from deploy/third-party/licences.
deploy/sbom-complete.cs reads both too. It takes an id ending in '*' in licences for every package id that starts
with the rest: the container's shared frameworks, which come with the base image, not from a restore. It adds a
component with 'addedBy': 'vpk' only to the SBOMs of the installers and update packages, where vpk adds it.
The Rust crates in Velopack's native binaries are in velopack-crates.json, written by velopack-crates.py.
